experience.title: Member of Technical Staff
points: Engineered and optimized complex Lightning Web Components (LWC) within OmniStudio Builder, enabling thousands of Salesforce admins and developers to create guided experiences with zero code; partnered cross-functionally with Product, UX, and Core Platform teams to support versioning, state persistence, and metadata-driven behavior.

Built on and contributed to OmniStudio's metadata-driven low-code runtime and server-side LWC code-generation pipeline, compiling admin-authored JSON into real LWC bundles on demand and producing dual-themed HTML (SLDS + Newport), FreeMarker-templated JS, and compiled ModuleDef definitions.

Owned and extended runtime LWC elements in a ~90-component shared library/base-class hierarchy, including WCAG 2.1 fixes, ARIA patterns, semantic markup, focus management, step-chart focus-order fixes, and prevention of unavailable-step activation across builder interfaces.

Engineered an event-driven data-JSON aggregation model using omniaggregate bubbling to a Header root and non-proxied string payloads, eliminating LWC reactive-proxy JSON.stringify performance overhead on large scripts.

Solved cross-namespace component resolution so one generator supports managed-package and core Salesforce orgs through runtime tag remapping; maintained strict backward compatibility through additive-only changes, stable @AuraEnabled signatures/preference keys, downstream-safe Spring beans, instrumentation, metrics, and UPL error logging.

Leveraged MCP and Cursor rules to design highly dynamic, configurable UI components, improving reusability and reducing new feature development time by over 30%; contributed to internal UI design frameworks and best practices for component composition, theming, and event-driven data binding.

Integrated a declarative Redux-style Designer with stores/reducers, 60+ property-set editors, and Luvio/Connect wire adapters, with live preview reusing the production runtime through a shared DESIGNER/PLAYER run-mode switch.

Delivered AI-assisted component authoring using Agentforce invocables and FlexCardSpecToJsonService, converting LLM design specifications into the same PropertySetConfig JSON consumed by the deterministic generator.

Refactored legacy Aura components into modern LWC architecture, improving rendering performance and cutting UI response latency by up to 40% in data-intensive modules; mentored developers on advanced LWC patterns, accessibility, and front-end performance optimization.
experience.about: Salesforce is a global enterprise software company best known for its cloud-based CRM platform. OmniStudio is its low-code toolkit for building guided, data-driven customer and employee experiences without writing code.
experience.summary: Member of Technical Staff on OmniStudio Builder, the low-code platform where admins author JSON metadata and the system generates production Lightning Web Components. Work spans the shared component library, the metadata-driven runtime, the code-generation pipeline and the designer experience, with Product, UX and Core Platform teams.
